assumptions.statement: Official detailed planning controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire access, heritage limits, and engineering constraints are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: All intensity, height, setback, implementation, and parcel-specific renewal conclusions remain conceptual and must be confirmed by a professional team.

assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons are repository-maintained rough geometry derived from public announcement text, location clues, and announced area values.
assumptions.impact: Use for intake and visualization only; replace all downstream geometry and metrics when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: AI public-space scenarios use data minimization, authorization, explainability, human review, appeal, and exit mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: No individual tracking or mandatory data collection is treated as necessary for the concept.
